name: Triangle: Cursed Town
storyline: Sent by the church to a remote village plagued by darkness, you and your team must uncover the truth behind a deadly curse. As night falls and an unholy presence awakens, you must search for evidence, decipher the origins of the evil, and perform forbidden rituals. The fate of the village rests on your ability to identify the supernatural force haunting its streets and put an end to the terror that has consumed it for generations.
summary: Triangle - Cursed Town is a 4-player online co-op atmospheric horror game. You and your friends are a team sent by the church. Together, you will enter the cursed village, try to collect as much evidence as possible, and complete the necessary ritual to lift the curse. The tools you find in the village will help you learn about the type of demon you're dealing with and uncover the mystery behind the curse.
